events.title: SunCon 2026 – Sunshine Coast Pop Culture Convention
events.description: A creative, community-driven fan event featuring celebrity guests, cosplay competitions, trivia, tournaments, Q&As, and stalls for fans of all pop culture genres, including Star Wars, The Hobbit, and Marvel.

events.title: Pranafest 2026 – Wellness & Music Festival
events.description: Queensland's leading festival for health, wellbeing, and conscious connection, featuring yoga, breathwork, live music, somatic workshops, and sacred talks by thought leaders like Bruce Lipton and Zach Bush.

events.title: 2026 Sunshine Coast Music Awards
events.description: A celebration of the region's thriving local music scene, where winners of the first-ever Sunshine Coast Music Awards will be announced.

events.title: Downunder Beachfest 2026 – Street Party & Live Music
events.description: A four-day festival celebrating classic cars and coastal lifestyle, starting with a street party featuring classic vehicles, live music, and local food, culminating in a large Car Show 'n' Shine.

events.title: DOLLY: I Will Always Love You – Live Tribute Show
events.description: A live theatrical tribute celebrating the music and life of Dolly Parton, offering an intimate, story-driven concert experience.

events.title: Kirsty Webeck: Lost for Words – Stand-Up Comedy
events.description: A stand-up comedy performance by Kirsty Webeck, one of Australia's leading sharp, witty, and critically acclaimed comedians.

events.title: Breathwork Class: Breathe, Connect & Relax
events.description: A grounded, community-oriented morning breathwork session designed for authentic wellness connection in a small group setting.

events.title: Sunshine Coast Murder Mystery 2: Crime on Date Night!
events.location: Sir Alec Roberts Park, Alexandra Headland
events.description: An interactive outdoor murder mystery experience, offering a fun, social, and creative way to meet curious and playful people.

events.title: Sunshine Coast Tiny Home Expo 2026
events.location: SHARKS Club, Pelican Waters Blvd, Caloundra
events.description: An expo offering inspiration, innovation, and real-world solutions for tiny houses on wheels, modulars, prefabs, off-grid living, and features speaker talks on alternative living and sustainable design.

events.title: Live Music at The Presynct – Various Gigs
events.description: The Presynct, an independent music venue, hosts various live gigs throughout the week, including bands like Screamfeeder, Allora, Lucid Safari, Prog Stomp, and Soul Groove.

events.title: Live Music at Imperial Hotel Eumundi
events.description: The Imperial Hotel Eumundi, a beloved hinterland pub, offers live music performances including artists like Ash Grunwald and tribute bands like The Buzz Lovers (Nirvana Tribute).

events.title: Live Music at Kings Beach Tavern
events.description: Kings Beach Tavern is a reliable live music venue hosting various shows throughout the week, including bands like Best Years of Our Lives and DON'T CHANGE – Ultimate INXS, attracting a regular community of music-goers.

events.title: Live Music – The J Noosa (Various Shows)
events.location: The J (Noosa Junction Arts & Leisure Centre), Noosa Junction
events.description: The J Noosa hosts a diverse program of live shows, including comedy, musical tributes, film screenings, and adventure film tours, catering to a range of creative and intellectually engaging interests.

events.title: Coastrek Sunshine Coast 2026 – Registration Closes This Week
events.datetime: Registration deadline: Sun 7 Jun | Event Day: Fri 17 Jul
events.description: This is the last week to register for Coastrek, an epic 50km, 30km, or 20km hiking challenge along the Sunshine Coast trail from Noosa to Mooloolaba, undertaken in teams to raise funds for Beyond Blue.

events.title: Melbourne International Comedy Festival Roadshow 2026
events.description: The annual touring showcase of the best emerging stand-up comedy talent from the Melbourne International Comedy Festival, promising an intimate, laugh-filled night.

events.title: Gutsy Girls Adventure Film Tour 2026
events.description: A curated program of short adventure films celebrating women pushing boundaries in the outdoors, ideal for adventure-minded and creatively curious audiences.
